exceptions.mechanism: One-shot Promise timeout around an external Tauri listener or command response.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The listener registration or typed bridge command resolves or rejects.
exceptions.reason: The renderer must expose a retryable startup failure when the external bridge never settles.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: The renderer reports failure; a late snapshot is rejected by request or revision fencing and never becomes timeout-derived success.
exceptions.cleanup: Listener registration marks itself cancelled and unregisters late listeners; request generations ignore late command responses.

exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The link load/error event and document.fonts promise establish the preview result.
exceptions.reason: A remote stylesheet request may never dispatch a terminal browser event.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: The preview is marked as an error and remains explicitly retryable; timeout never reports a loaded font.
exceptions.cleanup: The settle guard accepts the first terminal path and clears the timer.

exceptions.mechanism: Bounded expiry of a single synthetic shortcut suppression lease.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The matching key event consumes and removes the lease.
exceptions.reason: The remote page may never deliver the matching event after native input handoff.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Expiry only removes the exact suppression item; it does not infer page or macro state.
exceptions.cleanup: Explicit consume, clear, overlay disposal, and the item-scoped expiry all remove the same lease idempotently.

exceptions.mechanism: Bounded expiry of the one-shot click suppression listener after a pointer drag.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The next click event consumes the listener once.
exceptions.reason: A platform may omit the post-drag click, so the listener needs bounded cleanup.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Expiry removes only the listener and never changes drag or domain state.
exceptions.cleanup: The click handler clears the timer; the timer removes the exact capture listener.
